control.observed_difference: source-mutated tigrc removed the Enter binding, so the reviewed diff view never opened and gamma.txt never appeared

exclusions: The runner host was Windows amd64, but the pinned tig executable itself ran as Linux amd64 under WSL Ubuntu; this is not evidence of native Windows support.
macOS arm64 and native Linux runner hosts were not run in this record.
The retained executable acquisition time was not remeasured; 293 ms is warm offline WSL executable hash verification only.
The mutation build used exact tig-2.6.1 commit 04126d7d7c7aaabef2e932decfc8016d94648e41 after a clean rebuild.

The reviewed mutation changes the generated tigrc source from SHA-256 aa897801324f7f367fa6a487dd7c52b3d69384f93871656f083509131ca01d5b to b3a85e4a7cb53663800b52aaf5d6ed5e954860a16568de7b89c82518783a75fa; mutated executable SHA-256 is 7ebc721ade7879ead288cff137f2e0983d1a6c3c20fc6388dbeea2e94644ffc7.
Fixture SHA-256 is over a UTF-8 manifest of sorted relative path, tab, per-file SHA-256, and newline entries.
